gen-megrim-gf-aclonica: Angular and a bit sci-fi, with hairline strokes. Megrim draws every letter like spaghetti laid flat, while Aclonica sets a deep-bodied sans beneath it, with a thick-thin shift you feel more than see.
gen-megrim-gf-allerta: Allerta reads wide and loose, its tall lowercase spaced out like a plain sans stretching its legs. Then Megrim's ring-shaped o and wire-thin strokes sit above it, so a longer passage would feel spacious and unhurried.
gen-megrim-gf-alumni-sans: Alumni Sans reads low and understated, its ascenders barely clearing the x-height and its c pulled wide open. Alumni Sans gives Megrim's strict monoline a softer partner, with a slight reed-pen thickening that keeps the pair friendly.
gen-megrim-gf-alumni-sans-pinstripe: Approachable letters with oversized lowercase and tight word texture sit under Megrim's angular, futuristic heading, so the body feels sturdy against its thin line. A longer passage would read dense and compact.
gen-megrim-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Megrim cuts every stroke to a single depth, like an engraver who never pressed harder. Alumni Sans SC follows with squeezed, oversized lowercase and stems a touch heavier than hairlines, so a longer passage reads tight and contemporary.
gen-megrim-gf-anaheim: Anaheim packs its rounded sans-serif letters into a dense huddle that the eye glides through. Megrim is best at sharp, monoweight display lines, while Anaheim is best at filling a line with big, friendly lowercase.
gen-megrim-gf-arsenal: Megrim's thread of ink never swells or tapers. Arsenal keeps its sans-serif letters close-knit with a restrained weight shift in the curves, so a longer passage would flow smoothly and approachably.
gen-megrim-gf-arsenal-sc: Megrim's strokes have no thick or thin at all, just one wiry line. But Arsenal SC brings a faint, real contrast and a wide mouth, tight fit, which suits steady body text where the heading suits display.
gen-megrim-gf-asimovian: Megrim's c opens as wide as a bent paperclip, all angles and thin lines. And Asimovian answers with tall, single-width lowercase in a friendly sans, so the two feel like a rocket and its cheerful flight manual.
gen-megrim-gf-basic: Basic reads clean and businesslike, with only a gentle bump from small letters up to capitals. And Megrim's plotter-pen lines sit above it, giving the page a futuristic header over a quietly sensible sans.
